Les noces sont libres.", "sha256": "0a0fdfb84d654a693b2110ea329766061f69806e3707a26531c5ca1409fa0463", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0118", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ce n’est pas tout ça. Je te dis qu’il faut que tu tâches de me savoir ce que c’est que cette noce-là, dont est ce vieux, et où cette noce-là demeure.", "sha256": "fcd0e2e6a13f7594556bb77e8972999acd0ff67614df3a633f3a2beaf918131b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0119", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Plus souvent ! voilà qui sera drôle. Est-ce que c’est possible ?", "sha256": "a663b1fb1dc3b4c1eb514bb54adbbe13f554e7fccaa847ab156ea5906f2664b4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N8]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0120", "tag": "prose", "text": "— N’importe, il faudra tâcher. Entends-tu, Azelma ?", "sha256": "792091511387d9ba0f68d5157f68a99df9bcf5c8c5484c81f6c7215fa783e61f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0121", "tag": "prose", "text": "Les deux files reprirent des deux côtés du boulevard leur mouvement en sens inverse, et la voiture des masques perdit de vue « la roulotte » de la mariée.", "sha256": "c1db982ca52590c8fd42a882d9af0549dc69cf3fc01ee54911f80cbcf37cf264", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0122", "tag": "footnote", "text": "[[I]]Daron[[/I]], père.", "sha256": "24621da75cf3e04e93917fdeb19cc7fe532091ef89d66f3f6f2fbccef324adda", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0123", "tag": "footnote", "text": "[[I]]Roulotte[[/I]], voiture.", "sha256": "92e59aa78e8a06ca2995ab712b390d9678b5a548910701bede18b80b178c87bd", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0124", "tag": "footnote", "text": "Je veux qu’on me coupe le cou, et n’avoir de ma vie dit vous, toi, ni moi, si je ne connais pas ce parisien-là.", "sha256": "3229e1eea17f2de28c3537f29f232f232cae0daa90cdd2aa8cf2acdca4bc7c04", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0125", "tag": "footnote", "text": "[[I]]Filer[[/I]], suivre.", "sha256": "7ceae170eda767dd35a1be7287457d886ebd3521b8a4fec714492d5aaeb46ef5", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u351-r0126", "tag": "footnote", "text": "[[I]]Fée[[/I]], fille.", "sha256": "052431dfe66ed8dcc9dc19d880f58bf644729e3ea2019db939b8d745f7a3e27a", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
